two.reason: No concrete fraud indicator is established. $1,250 exceeds the $1,000 new-vendor low-amount leniency threshold, so that special presumption cannot justify closure; the amount alone does not establish fraud. Invoice approval is not a Fraud conclusion.
required_actions: Assess independently and report these limitations; no fraud flag is required solely for being new.
If uncertainty warrants review, defer and seek supporting documentation or broader history.
